Container.Name: isitdown-light

Branch.TagDescription: Polling and notifications only, configured by a file. No web server.

Container.Overview:
IsItDown polls the public status pages of the providers you depend on — GitHub, Cloudflare, AWS, Anthropic and the rest — and tells you when one of them changes state.
This is the Light edition: polling and notifications, nothing else. There is no web interface and no port; everything it monitors and every channel it sends through is described in one config.yml.
Before starting it, put a config.yml in the path mapped below — copy config.example.yml from the repository and edit it. Credentials are never written in that file: it references ${ENV_VAR} names, and the values come from the variables here. An invalid file stops the container at boot with the reason, rather than starting half-configured and quietly alerting nobody.

Config.Name: config.yml
Config.Description: The configuration file. Copy config.example.yml from the repository and edit it.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The state file: what each provider last looked like, so a restart does not replay old news.
